2608.26923.title: TabuLM: Morphology-Aware Tabular Pre-training for Low-Resource Languages
2608.26923.paper_summary: We present TabuLM, the first language model pre-trained on Kinyarwanda tabular data. Kinyarwanda is a morphologically rich Bantu language spoken by over 12 million people in Rwanda, yet lacks any dedicated tabular representation learning resource. TabuLM extends KinyaBERT-large, a two-tier morphological transformer, with additive row, column, and cell-type embeddings and a learned table-structure attention bias that sharpens same-row and same-column attention. Pre-training uses two new objectives: Masked Cell Recovery (MCR), which masks entire cells and forces reconstruction from row and column context, and Column Type Prediction (CTP), which predicts column semantic types from observed cell values. We pre-train on 172 Rwandan government tables (~35,000 cells) from NISR, RAB, REB, and MoH open-data portals, and introduce TabQA-kin, the first native Kinyarwanda table question-answering benchmark comprising 526 QA pairs across 31 tables and four question types. TabuLM achieves 62.0% exact match on TabQA-kin, outperforming KinyaBERT-large by 5.7 EM points and all multilingual baselines (mBERT 49.3%, XLM-R 50.0%) by 11.7-12.7 points. Analysis shows that structural table embeddings are most decisive for comparison and lookup questions, while morphological awareness provides complementary gains. Our code, data, and pre-trained checkpoint are publicly available.
2608.26923.paper_summary_zh: 我們提出了TabuLM，這是第一個在基尼亞萬達表格數據上進行預訓練的語言模型。基尼亞萬達是一種形態豐富的班圖語言，約有1200萬人在盧旺達使用，但缺乏任何專門的表格表示學習資源。TabuLM擴展了KinyaBERT-large，一種兩層形態Transformer，並加入了附加的行、列和單元格類型嵌入，以及一個學習的表格結構注意力偏置，這使得同一行和同一列的注意力更加明確。預訓練使用了兩個新的目標：遮蔽單元恢復（MCR），它會遮蔽整個單元格並強迫從行和列的上下文中重建，以及列類型預測（CTP），它根據觀察到的單元格值預測列的語義類型。我們在來自NISR、RAB、REB和衛生部開放數據平台的172個盧旺達政府表格（約35,000個單元格）上進行預訓練，並引入了TabQA-kin，這是第一個本土基尼亞萬達表格問答基準，包括31個表格和四種類型的526對問答。TabuLM在TabQA-kin上達到了62.0%的精確匹配，超過了KinyaBERT-large 5.7個EM點，並且比所有多語言基準（mBERT 49.3%，XLM-R 50.0%）高出11.7-12.7個點。分析顯示，結構性表格嵌入對於比較和查詢問題最為關鍵，而形態意識則提供了補充的增益。我們的代碼、數據和預訓練檢查點均已公開。
